---
title: "Experiment Explorer"
description: "Filter, search, and compare experiment runs by model, prompt version, sample size, and accuracy; inspect per-class and confusion-matrix views."
format:
  html:
    toc: false
observable:
  libraries:
    - d3@7
    - "observablehq/plot@0.6"
---

Browse every recorded evaluation run. Data is parsed from the committed markdown reports (`docs/experiments/experiment_log.md`, `reports/experiment_reports/`, `reports/confusion_matrices/`) and ships with the site, so filtering and views run entirely in your browser.

```{ojs}
exp = FileAttachment("../data/experiments.json").json()
perClass = FileAttachment("../data/per-class-accuracy.json").json()
confusions = FileAttachment("../data/confusion-matrices.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
models = [...new Set(exp.experiments.map(r => r.model_short))].sort()
prompts = [...new Set(exp.experiments.map(r => r.prompt_version))].sort((a,b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, {numeric: true}))
sizes = [...new Set(exp.experiments.map(r => r.images))].sort((a,b) => a - b)
```

## Filters

```{ojs}
viewof modelFilter = Inputs.select(["All", ...models], {label: "Model"})
viewof promptFilter = Inputs.select(["All", ...prompts], {label: "Prompt version"})
viewof sizeFilter = Inputs.select(["All", ...sizes], {label: "Sample size (images)"})
viewof searchText = Inputs.text({label: "Free-text search (id, dataset)", placeholder: "e.g. v12retro or smoke", value: ""})
viewof minAcc = Inputs.range([0, 100], {label: "Minimum accuracy (%)", value: 0, step: 1})
```

```{ojs}
filtered = exp.experiments.filter(r =>
  (modelFilter === "All" || r.model_short === modelFilter) &&
  (promptFilter === "All" || r.prompt_version === promptFilter) &&
  (sizeFilter === "All" || r.images === sizeFilter) &&
  ((r.accuracy || 0) * 100) >= minAcc &&
  (searchText === "" || `${r.id || ""} ${r.dataset || ""} ${r.name || ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()))
).sort((a, b) => (b.accuracy || 0) - (a.accuracy || 0))
```

## Summary

```{ojs}
summary = {
  const n = filtered.length;
  const accs = filtered.map(r => r.accuracy || 0);
  const imgs = d3.sum(filtered, r => r.images || 0);
  return html`<div class="sum-grid">
    <div><span class="k">Runs</span><span class="v">${n}</span></div>
    <div><span class="k">Models</span><span class="v">${new Set(filtered.map(r => r.model_short)).size}</span></div>
    <div><span class="k">Images classified</span><span class="v">${imgs.toLocaleString()}</span></div>
    <div><span class="k">Best accuracy</span><span class="v">${n ? (d3.max(accs) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" : "—"}</span></div>
    <div><span class="k">Mean accuracy</span><span class="v">${n ? (d3.mean(accs) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" : "—"}</span></div>
    <div><span class="k">Worst accuracy</span><span class="v">${n ? (d3.min(accs) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" : "—"}</span></div>
  </div>`
}
```

## Runs table (click headers to sort)

```{ojs}
table = Inputs.table(filtered, {
  columns: [
    {column: "model_short", label: "Model"},
    {column: "prompt_version", label: "Prompt"},
    {column: "images", label: "Images"},
    {column: "accuracy", label: "Accuracy", format: a => a == null ? "—" : (a * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"},
    {column: "correct", label: "Correct"},
    {column: "total", label: "Total"},
    {column: "expected_cost", label: "Expected $", format: v => v == null ? "—" : "$" + v.toFixed(4)},
    {column: "actual_cost", label: "Actual $", format: v => v == null ? "—" : "$" + v.toFixed(4)},
    {column: "id", label: "ID"},
    {column: "dataset", label: "Dataset"}
  ],
  maxHeight: 400,
  sort: "accuracy",
  reverse: true
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof downloadCsv = Inputs.button("Download filtered results (CSV)", {
  reduce: _ => {
    const rows = filtered.map(r => ({
      model: r.model_short,
      prompt: r.prompt_version,
      images: r.images,
      accuracy: r.accuracy == null ? "" : (r.accuracy * 100).toFixed(2) + "%",
      correct: r.correct ?? "",
      total: r.total ?? "",
      expected_cost_usd: r.expected_cost ?? "",
      actual_cost_usd: r.actual_cost ?? "",
      dataset: r.dataset ?? "",
      id: r.id ?? ""
    }));
    const blob = new Blob([d3.csvFormat(rows)], {type: "text/csv"});
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = "experiments.csv";
    a.click();
  }
})
```

## Views

### Accuracy by model

```{ojs}
byModel = d3.rollups(filtered, v => d3.mean(v, r => r.accuracy || 0), r => r.model_short)
  .map(([model, accuracy]) => ({model, accuracy}))
  .sort((a, b) => b.accuracy - a.accuracy)
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(byModel, {x: "accuracy", y: "model", sort: {x: "y", reverse: true}, fill: "#2a9d8f", title: d => (d.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"}),
    Plot.text(byModel, {x: "accuracy", y: "model", text: d => (d.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1) + "%", dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11})
  ],
  height: byModel.length * 42 + 40,
  marginLeft: 180,
  marginRight: 80,
  x: {grid: true, tickFormat: p => (p * 100).toFixed(0) + "%", label: "Mean exact-match accuracy", domain: [0, Math.max(...byModel.map(d => d.accuracy)) * 1.12]},
  y: {label: null},
  style: {backgroundColor: "white", color: "#222"}
})
```

### Accuracy by prompt version

```{ojs}
byPrompt = d3.rollups(filtered, v => d3.mean(v, r => r.accuracy || 0), r => r.prompt_version)
  .map(([prompt, accuracy]) => ({prompt, accuracy}))
  .sort((a, b) => a.prompt.localeCompare(b.prompt, undefined, {numeric: true}))
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(byPrompt, {x: "prompt", y: "accuracy", fill: "#e76f51", title: d => (d.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ],
  y: {grid: true, tickFormat: p => (p * 100).toFixed(0) + "%", label: "Mean accuracy"},
  x: {label: "Prompt version"},
  style: {backgroundColor: "white", color: "#222"}
})
```

### Accuracy vs sample size

```{ojs}
bySize = d3.rollups(filtered, v => d3.mean(v, r => r.accuracy || 0), r => r.images)
  .map(([images, accuracy]) => ({images, accuracy}))
  .sort((a, b) => a.images - b.images)
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.line(bySize, {x: "images", y: "accuracy", curve: "linear", stroke: "#264653", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot(bySize, {x: "images", y: "accuracy", fill: "#264653", title: d => (d.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ],
  x: {label: "Sample size (images)", grid: true},
  y: {tickFormat: p => (p * 100).toFixed(0) + "%", label: "Mean accuracy"},
  style: {backgroundColor: "white", color: "#222"}
})
```

### Per-class accuracy — pick a run

```{ojs}
viewof pcaKey = Inputs.select(Object.keys(perClass).sort(), {label: "Report", value: "qwen3.7-flash_v11.8_1600_balanced_1120_final" in perClass ? "qwen3.7-flash_v11.8_1600_balanced_1120_final" : Object.keys(perClass)[0]})
```

```{ojs}
pcaRows = Object.entries(perClass[pcaKey] || {}).map(([cls, v]) => ({cls, accuracy: v.accuracy, correct: v.correct, total: v.total}))
```

```{ojs}
abbrOf = (s) => (s === "scientific_publication" ? "sci_pub" : s === "scientific_report" ? "sci_rep" : (s || "").slice(0, 6))
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(pcaRows, {x: "cls", y: "accuracy", fill: (d) => d.accuracy >= 0.9 ? "#2a9d8f" : d.accuracy >= 0.7 ? "#e9c46a" : "#e76f51", sort: {x: "y"}, title: d => `${d.cls}: ${(d.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}% (${d.correct}/${d.total})`}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ],
  height: 420,
  insetTop: 10,
  insetBottom: 4,
  marginBottom: 60,
  style: {fontSize: 12, backgroundColor: "white", color: "#222"},
  x: {label: null, tickRotate: -40, tickSize: 4, tickFormat: d => abbrOf(d), tickPadding: 6},
  y: {grid: true, tickFormat: p => (p * 100).toFixed(0) + "%", label: "Accuracy"}
})
```

### Confusion matrix — pick a run

```{ojs}
viewof confKey = Inputs.select(Object.keys(confusions).sort(), {label: "Confusion matrix", value: Object.keys(confusions)[0]})
```

```{ojs}
confRows = {
  const c = confusions[confKey] || {labels: [], matrix: []};
  const out = [];
  c.labels.forEach((exp, i) => c.labels.forEach((pred, j) => {
    out.push({expected: exp, predicted: pred, count: c.matrix[i]?.[j] || 0});
  }));
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.cell(confRows, {x: "predicted", y: "expected", fill: "count", title: d => `${d.expected} → ${d.predicted}: ${d.count}`}),
    Plot.text(confRows, {x: "predicted", y: "expected", text: "count", fontSize: 9, fill: d => d.count > 0 ? "#222" : "transparent"})
  ],
  height: 640,
  insetTop: 10,
  marginBottom: 70,
  marginLeft: 95,
  style: {fontSize: 12, backgroundColor: "white", color: "#222"},
  x: {label: "Predicted", tickRotate: -45, tickSize: 4, tickFormat: d => abbrOf(d), tickPadding: 6},
  y: {label: "Expected", tickFormat: d => abbrOf(d)},
  color: {scheme: "YlOrRd", legend: true, type: "linear"}
})
```

::: {.callout-note}
The table, charts, and CSV export always reflect the current filters. All values come from committed markdown reports — no API access required. Download the CSV to share the filtered subset with collaborators.
:::
